mentions.description: A simple link-in-bio web service built with Django and Vue that hosts a personal page of links for its users. Built as a project to learn Django and Vue and deploy something working online; it has attracted a handful of free users.

A really simple link-in-bio service:

Mostly just wanted to learn Django and Vue and see if I could get something working online.
